selection_rationale: Directly targets the highest-priority unresolved gap (adversarial robustness of LLM+verifier NetOps pipelines), scores highest on novelty/falsifiability/venue relevance in critic reviews, and is feasible within the stated resource budget; other candidates either scored lower on novelty or require substantial design repairs before preregistration.
unresolved_uncertainties: UQ2: NetOps-specific robustness to adversarial or correlated failure modes remains uncharacterized (see 10.1007/s10994-025-06862-6; https://openalex.org/W4388629193).

UQ1: Production-scale correctness and safety of LLM+verifier pipelines across heterogeneous, multi-vendor networks is unresolved and may limit external validity (see https://openalex.org/W4399629579; https://openalex.org/W4388629193).

UQ4: End-to-end performance–cost tradeoffs (latency, verifier runtime, audit overhead) for closed-loop verify→refine pipelines under realistic change volumes are incompletely quantified and may affect operational conclusions (see https://openalex.org/W4362508231).
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Include at least one secondary LLM family or lightweight model-ensemble check (or justify single-model freeze) to assess transferability.
Specify and publish complete adversary-generation procedures, seeds, constraints, and include a human-review filter to avoid degenerate/unrealistic adversaries.
Document simulator fidelity and pre-register sensitivity tests (vary topology size, vendor command sets) to bound external-validity claims.
Pre-register exact deterministic verifier rules and the mapping/taxonomy from verifier diagnostics to defined safety-violation categories.
